_about: Performance budgets (milliseconds, the median of midgard_bench's runs), checked by tools/budgets.py. A benchmark fails when it takes longer than its budget plus the margin. 'default' applies everywhere unless a platform has its own value; CI's platforms are named ci-<preset>, and its Linux jobs render with software Vulkan (lavapipe), so GPU budgets there are much larger. Every benchmark needs a budget.
